products.name: AA/AAA household LED torch
products.suits: Flats and houses that want common batteries and simple indoor navigation during a power cut.
limitations: Runtime claims vary widely—treat peak lumen figures as marketing unless measured
Not a substitute for leaving quickly in a fire
reviewFlags: Manufacturer runtime at turbo mode is unverified—do not publish as a measured figure without a firsthand test

products.name: Compact LED headlamp
products.suits: Households that need hands-free light for finding kit, caring for others or short outdoor checks.
specs: Red or low mode useful to preserve night vision
limitations: Headbands can fail in damp storage—check elastics on review
Phone torch still drains the handset; keep a dedicated light

products.name: USB-C mid-capacity power bank
products.suits: Keeping one phone available for essential calls during a short outage.
specs: Capacity stated in Wh or mAh
limitations: Self-discharge in a drawer is unverified until tested
Not assumed suitable for medical devices—confirm with the manufacturer
reviewFlags: Unsupported safety claim risk: never imply a consumer power bank is approved for medical equipment without manufacturer guidance

products.name: Battery or wind-up FM radio
products.suits: Hearing updates when broadband and mobile data are unavailable.
limitations: Indoor reception varies by building—desk research cannot guarantee performance at your address
DAB is optional for outage basics

products.name: Food-grade water carrier
products.suits: Households topping up beyond bottled water for a known shut-off or three-day buffer.
specs: Size you can lift and store
limitations: Does not make floodwater safe to drink
Static stores need rotation on the six-month review

products.name: Compact home first-aid kit
products.suits: Topping up plasters and sterile dressings for everyday injuries and short disruption.
specs: Antiseptic and basic extras as listed by the maker
limitations: Prescribed medication stays with the household, not inside a sealed kit alone
BS workplace kit claims need verification against the stated standard
reviewFlags: Unverified specification: any BS compliance claim must match the kit’s labelling before publication

products.name: Winter car basics (hi-vis, warmth, shovel)
products.suits: Drivers who may face short winter delays—not expedition motoring.
limitations: Jump-lead suitability for hybrids/EVs is vehicle-specific—unverified generically
A boot kit is not a reason to ignore Met Office travel advice
reviewFlags: Unsupported safety claim risk: do not state legal duties for warning triangles/hi-vis without citing current rules
